caption: The drawing contains several individual objects, all rendered in a realistic style and spaced apart on a plain off-white background. At the top center, there is a vertically-oriented wooden molding with a cloth draped over it, edged with subtle shadowing. On each side of this central object, there are shorter horizontal sections of wood trim painted in medium brown tones. Below the center, there is a brass drawer pull shaped like a handle with decorative floral mounts on both ends, and to the left of the pull, a small metal latch colored a bluish-gray, consisting of two joined pieces. To the right of the pull, there is a flat lever attachment with a circular detail, shown in a light tan shade. Below the pull, there is a spherical brown wooden knob, a conically cleft wooden spindle, and, taking up the bottom portion, a rectangular panel of wood with a simple curved lower edge rendered in shades of medium and dark brown. The artist's signature, "Edward T. Jewett," appears in the lower right portion of the drawing. The overall composition isolates each object, giving equal space between them, and the colors are predominantly natural wood and muted metallic tones.
title: Cupboard for Corner
